info.title: Skillplate External API
info.description:
External API for managing users, enrollments, orders, subscriptions, and discounts.

## Authentication

All requests require a **Personal Access Token (PAT)** passed as a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer 30301d6451xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

The tenant context is automatically resolved from the PAT — no need to specify the tenant separately. Generate tokens from your dashboard under **Settings → API Tokens**.

## API Versioning

The API uses URL-based versioning:

| Version | Base URL |
|---------|----------|
| v1 (current) | `https://api.skillplate.com/v1/external` |

All responses include an `X-API-Supported-Versions` header listing currently supported versions.

### Deprecation

When a version is deprecated, responses will include:
- `Deprecation: true` — Indicates the version is deprecated
- `Sunset: <date>` — RFC 7231 date when the version will be removed
- `X-API-Deprecation-Info` — Human-readable migration guidance

Monitor these headers to plan migrations before sunset dates.

## IDs

All resource IDs (users, products, orders, etc.) are **hashed strings**, not plain integers. Always treat them as opaque identifiers.

## Rate Limits

| Operation | Limit |
|-----------|-------|
| Read (GET) | 100 requests/minute |
| Write (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) | 30 requests/minute |
| Burst | 10 requests/second |

Rate limit status is returned in response headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

## Scopes

Tokens can be created with specific scopes to limit access:

| Scope | Access |
|-------|--------|
| `users:read` | Read user data and list users |
| `users:write` | Create, update, delete users and manage enrollments |
| `discounts:read` | Read discount codes |
| `discounts:write` | Create, update, activate/deactivate discount codes |
| `products:read` | Read product catalog |
| `subscriptions:write` | Create, update, cancel subscriptions and report payments |
| `orders:write` | Create orders and update order status |

## Webhooks

Skillplate can send webhook events to your configured endpoint URL when important events occur. Webhook payloads are signed using **HMAC-SHA256** — verify the `X-Skillplate-Signature` header to ensure authenticity.

**Supported webhook events:**

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `payment.succeeded` | A payment was successfully processed |
| `payment.failed` | A payment attempt failed |
| `subscription.started` | A new subscription was activated |
| `subscription.cancelled` | A subscription was cancelled |
| `user.created` | A new user was created |
| `user.updated` | A user's profile was updated |
| `lesson.completed` | A user completed a lesson |
| `module.completed` | A user completed a course module |
| `course.completed` | A user completed an entire course |

`payment.succeeded` and `payment.failed` payloads include an `items[]` array; each item contains a `product_id` (hashed) identifying the purchased product.

Configure webhook endpoints in your dashboard under **Settings → Webhooks**.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users. By default, only non-lead users are returned.

parameters.name: filter[tags]
parameters.description: Filter users by tag name. Accepts a comma-separated string (`filter[tags]=premium,vip`) or repeated array notation (`filter[tags][]=premium&filter[tags][]=vip`). Returns users that match **any** of the provided tags.

parameters.name: lead
parameters.description: Filter by lead status. Default is false (non-leads only).

post.description: Creates a new user in the tenant. Optionally enrolls them in products and sends a welcome email.

get.description: Retrieves a single user by their ID.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to include. Tags are not included by default and must be requested explicitly.

put.description: Updates an existing user. All fields are optional for partial updates.

delete.description: Deletes a user and all their related data. Cannot delete the tenant owner.

post.description: Enrolls a user in one or more products. Idempotent - already enrolled products return 'already_enrolled' status.
Unenrolls a user from one or more products. Idempotent - products not enrolled return 'not_enrolled' status.

Issues a certificate for a user on a specific course module. Marks all lessons and the module as completed, then asynchronously generates the certificate PDF and emails the user. Idempotent - if the user already has a certificate for the module, returns 'already_certified' status.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of discounts with optional filtering.

parameters.name: created_to
parameters.description: Filter by creation date end (inclusive, must be after or equal to created_from)

post.description: Creates a new discount code. Either percent_off or amount_off must be provided, but not both.

get.description: Retrieves a single discount by its ID.

put.description: Updates an existing discount. All fields are optional for partial updates.

post.description: Activates a discount by setting active=true and clearing the end date.
Deactivates a discount by setting active=false.
Creates a new external subscription for a user and product. If user_id is not provided, a user will be looked up or created using the email, first_name, and last_name fields.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of subscriptions. Requires the subscriptions:read scope.

patch.description: Updates an existing subscription. Allows changing the next payment attempt date and billing period.

get.description: Returns a single subscription by ID. Requires the subscriptions:read scope.

post.description: Cancels a subscription. The cancellation can take effect immediately, at the end of the current billing period, or on a specific date.
Reports a successful payment for a subscription. Records the payment amount and resets the failed payment counter.
Reports a failed payment for a subscription. Increments the failed payment counter.

get.description: Returns all products grouped by type (courses, bundles, digital_downloads, generics, communities) with their active pricing options. The returned product IDs can be used with enrollment and discount endpoints. Price IDs can be used with the apply_for_prices field in discount endpoints. Use item_id parameter to search for a product by its underlying course/bundle ID.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Search by underlying item ID (course ID, bundle ID, etc.) to find matching products. Returns an array of matches (multiple products can share the same item_id across different types).

post.description: Creates a new order. If user_id is not provided, a user will be looked up or created using the email, first_name, and last_name fields.

new_user_order.summary: New user order — creates user and order together

existing_user_with_discount.summary: Existing user with discount code applied

get.description: Returns a paginated list of orders. Requires the orders:read scope.

post.description: Updates the status of an existing order.

get.description: Returns a single order by ID. Requires the orders:read scope.

BearerAuth.description: Personal Access Token (PAT). Generate from your dashboard settings. The token contains your tenant context, so all requests are automatically scoped to your tenant.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the current time window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current time window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the current rate limit window resets.

X-API-Supported-Versions.description: Comma-separated list of currently supported API versions. Always present in every response.

Deprecation.description: Present and set to 'true' when the requested API version is deprecated. Monitor this header to plan migrations.

Sunset.description: RFC 7231 date when the deprecated version will be removed. Only present for deprecated versions with a configured sunset date.

schema.example: API version v1 is deprecated. Please migrate to the latest version.

X-API-Deprecation-Info.description: Human-readable migration guidance. Only present for deprecated versions.

tags.name: Users
tags.description:
Create, read, update, and delete users in your tenant.

**Required scopes:** `users:read` (GET), `users:write` (POST/PUT/DELETE)

> All user IDs are hashed strings. Use `filter[email]` to look up a user by email address.

tags.name: Enrollments
tags.description:
Enroll or unenroll users from products (courses, bundles, digital downloads, etc.).

**Required scope:** `users:write`

> Enrollment is **idempotent** — enrolling an already-enrolled user returns `already_enrolled` without error.

tags.name: Certificates
tags.description:
Issue certificates to users for completing course modules. Certificate generation and email delivery are processed asynchronously.

**Required scope:** `users:write`

> Certification is **idempotent** — certifying an already-certified user returns `already_certified`.

tags.name: Discounts
tags.description:
Manage discount codes for your products. Supports percentage and fixed-amount discounts with optional date ranges, usage limits, and subscription duration controls.

**Required scopes:** `discounts:read` (GET), `discounts:write` (POST/PUT)

> Either `percent_off` or `amount_off` is required when creating a discount — not both.

tags.name: Products
tags.description:
Read your product catalog including courses, bundles, digital downloads, generics, and communities. Returns active pricing options for each product.

**Required scope:** `products:read`

> Use `item_id` parameter to find a product by its underlying course/bundle ID.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description:
Create and manage external subscriptions for users. Report payment success/failure to keep subscription state in sync with your payment processor.

**Required scope:** `subscriptions:write`

> If `user_id` is omitted, a user is looked up or created using `email`, `first_name`, and `last_name`.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description:
Create orders for users and update their status. Orders automatically enroll users in purchased products when marked as `completed`.

**Required scope:** `orders:write`

> If `user_id` is omitted, a user is looked up or created using `email`, `first_name`, and `last_name`.
